patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Demandbase share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Adapt.io only if your buying job matches “Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Cust” rather than Demandbase's shape. Choose Demandbase only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-marke” rather than Adapt.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Adapt.io leans contact-management; Demandbase leans lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Demandbase share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Adapt.io is Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Custom contact sales; 7-day trial.; Demandbase is Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-market orchestration — custom-quote packaging..
- Company-size focus: Adapt.io (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Demandbase (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adapt.io-leaning contact-management vs Demandbase-leaning lead-management.
- Researched limits: Adapt.io — Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; Demandbase — Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices.

Limitations — Adapt.io: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; No native email sequencing — data/export first; Demandbase: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Enterprise ABM scope means substantial implementation and change-management cost.

Poor-fit cases: Adapt.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches · Demandbase is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices · Avoid Adapt.io if you actually need Demandbase's motion (Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and g)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
